THE_QUESTION: Can one shared latent-conditioned PPO policy preserve two complementary strategic roles when each latent receives its associated on-policy strategic environment, while selective counterfactual rehearsal only reinforces the states where its specialist is actually better?

AUTHORIZED_TREATMENT.initialisation: FRESH, step 0. No checkpoint weights, no optimizer reuse.
AUTHORIZED_TREATMENT.z0_rollout: Pole A -- OP6 + SDS2_A_payoff_INIT_3 overlay (16 envs)
AUTHORIZED_TREATMENT.z1_rollout: Pole B -- OP7, no overlay (16 envs)

rehearsal.tied_delta_eq_0: ZERO strategic pressure; other latent untouched

PARAMETERS_RESOLVED.seed_block_audit: 10700001-10700160 is the stratified collection (FIT/CALIB/EVAL); 10800001 is the rollout smoke. 10900001 is clean.
PARAMETERS_RESOLVED.rehearsal_param_provenance: The spec froze cadence and strength by POINTER -- 'unchanged from the existing validated SAPPO-style rehearsal'. Resolved from PPOConfig defaults sappo_anchor_lambda / _cadence / _batch_size. Looked up, not invented.

BUDGET_DECISION_AND_ITS_CAVEAT.CAVEAT_TO_STATE_IN_ANY_COMPARISON: EXP2C -- the closest thing to a control for this experiment, being the same architecture and poles WITHOUT oracle-gated rehearsal -- ran 2,002,944 steps. This run is half that. Any comparison between them therefore carries a budget difference and cannot attribute a difference in outcome to oracle gating alone. Recorded now, before the result exists, so it is a stated limitation rather than a discovered one.
BUDGET_DECISION_AND_ITS_CAVEAT.what_would_remove_the_caveat: a 2M arm, which is a separate budget decision

GATES.gold_standard: strategic payoff and crossover on EVAL, scored once

STOP_CONDITION.rule: If ANY runtime auditor fires, classify the attempt INVALID_TREATMENT and STOP.
STOP_CONDITION.prohibited: repairing the treatment mid-run and continuing
STOP_CONDITION.why: a run whose treatment changed partway through answers no question
